title: Git Namespaces — Create Repository — payload
description: A holder of `git.repo.create` on a namespace creates a repository in it and becomes its owner. The VTC reserves the name; a bridge creates the repository and turns commit trust on, or, where no bot can create repositories there, the response lists the steps a person must take.

namespace.description: The namespace to create the repository in.

name.description: The repository name, lowercased. The repository's resource is `<forge>/<owner>/<name>`.

description.description: A one-line description for the forge's repository page.

Response.title: Git Namespaces — Create Repository — response payload
Response.description: The reserved repository, and the manual steps when a person must create it.

repo.description: The repository as recorded — normally `pendingCreate` at this point.

manualSteps.description: Present when no bot can create repositories in this namespace (a manual-mode namespace, or a personal account): the steps, in order, that a person with forge access carries out. The repository becomes `active` when it is then adopted with git-ns/repo/adopt.
